summary: H.R. 6703, titled the "Lower Health Care Premiums for All Americans Act," amends the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, the Public Health Service Act, and the Internal Revenue Code of 1986. It sets rules for association health plans, excludes certain stop-loss insurance from health insurance coverage definitions, allows custom health option and individual care expense arrangements, adds oversight and reporting rules for pharmacy benefit managers, and provides appropriations for cost-sharing reduction payments beginning January 1, 2027.

affected_groups.effect: May establish group health plans under specified rules without needing to be in the same industry, subject to association and organizational criteria.
Can be treated as employers and employees for participating in certain association health plans under specific monitoring rules.
Must enter into contracts agreeing to provide specific reporting on drug claims, pricing, and remuneration, subject to civil monetary penalties for violations or false information.
Receive rights to request summary documents and specific claims-level information regarding prescription drug pricing, net spending, and rebates.

key_provisions: Establishes rules and requirements for group health plans maintained by groups or associations of employers, including requirements for governing boards, formal structure, and prohibitions on health status discrimination.
Excludes medical stop-loss policies obtained by self-insured group health plans or sponsors from the definition of health insurance coverage.
Provides rules for custom health option and individual care expense arrangements, including definitions, nondiscrimination, substantiation, and notice requirements.
Requires entities providing pharmacy benefit management services to submit regular, detailed reports on drug claims, spending, and rebates to group health plans.

Appropriates necessary funds for cost-sharing reduction payments for plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2027, with limitations on covering abortion services except in cases of rape, incest, or danger to the life of the mother.
missing_information: The specific dollar amounts for the appropriations for cost-sharing reduction payments are not stated.
Detailed regulatory criteria or definitions that the Secretary is directed to issue through future rulemaking are not provided.
summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 6703, titled the "Lower Health Care Premiums for All Americans Act," amends the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, the Public Health Service Act, and the Internal Revenue Code of 1986. It sets rules for association health plans, excludes certain stop-loss insurance from health insurance coverage definitions, allows custom health option and individual care expense arrangements, adds oversight and reporting rules for pharmacy benefit managers, and provides appropriations for cost-sharing reduction payments beginning January 1, 2027.
summary_detail.significance: The bill alters federal laws governing health insurance options, association health plans, health reimbursement arrangements, and pharmacy benefit manager transparency, and appropriates funds for cost-sharing reductions starting in 2027.
